parts.label: Front Brake Rotor — 318mm Cross-Drilled Vented (Left)
parts.function: 318 x 28 mm cross-drilled, involute-shaped internally vented cast-iron disc. On the 987.2 (from MY2009) all models run this front disc — the basic Boxster/Cayman moved up from the 987.1's 298 x 24 mm to the S size.

parts.label: Front Brake Rotor — 318mm Cross-Drilled Vented (Right)
parts.function: 318 x 28 mm cross-drilled, involute-shaped internally vented cast-iron disc. On the 987.2 (from MY2009) all models run this front disc — the basic Boxster/Cayman moved up from the 987.1's 298 x 24 mm to the S size.

parts.label: Front Brake Caliper — 4-Piston Monobloc (Left)
parts.function: Fixed 4-piston aluminium monobloc caliper clamping the pads against the front left rotor. Black anodized on the 2.9 base cars, red on Boxster S / Cayman S, yellow with the optional PCCB ceramic brake.

parts.label: Front Brake Caliper — 4-Piston Monobloc (Right)
parts.function: Fixed 4-piston aluminium monobloc caliper clamping the pads against the front right rotor. Black anodized on the 2.9 base cars, red on Boxster S / Cayman S, yellow with the optional PCCB ceramic brake.

parts.label: Front Brake Pads
parts.function: Friction pads inside the fixed monobloc caliper. Front-left carries the wear sensor; bed new pads in gently over the first ~200 miles.

parts.label: Brake Master Cylinder
parts.function: Tandem master cylinder converting brake pedal force into hydraulic pressure for both brake circuits, mounted on the booster at the front bulkhead.

parts.label: Brake Booster (Vacuum Servo)
parts.function: Vacuum servo amplifying pedal input before the master cylinder. For MY2009 the boost ratio was raised to i=5.0 with the steel-disc brake (i=4.5 is retained with PCCB).

parts.label: ABS/PSM Hydraulic Control Unit
parts.function: PSM hydraulic modulator (4-channel ABS, ABD, ASR, MSR, EBD) regulating pressure per wheel. The 987.2 unit adds enhanced longitudinal dynamics control: brake pre-filling, brake assist and drive-off assistant.

parts.label: Front Brake Lines — Hard Lines and Flex Hoses
parts.function: Transmits hydraulic fluid pressure from the ABS/PSM unit to the front brake calipers via steel hard lines and flexible hoses at the struts.

parts.label: Brake Fluid Reservoir
parts.function: Stores and supplies brake fluid to the master cylinder while accommodating fluid volume changes as pads wear. Fluid change every 2 years on the 987 schedule.

parts.label: Wheel Speed Sensor — Front Left
parts.function: Provides real-time front left wheel rotational speed data to the ABS/PSM control unit for slip detection and stability interventions.

parts.label: Wheel Speed Sensor — Front Right
parts.function: Provides real-time front right wheel rotational speed data to the ABS/PSM control unit for slip detection and stability interventions.

parts.label: Front Brake Dust Shield (Cover Plate) — Left
parts.function: Shields the front left brake rotor and caliper from road debris, splash water, and dirt ingress.

parts.label: Front Brake Dust Shield (Cover Plate) — Right
parts.function: Shields the front right brake rotor and caliper from road debris, splash water, and dirt ingress.

parts.label: Front Brake Caliper Repair Set (Seals & Pistons)
parts.function: Replacement seal and piston kit for rebuilding the front fixed caliper to restore hydraulic integrity and prevent fluid leaks.

parts.label: Brake Fluid (DOT 4)
parts.function: High-performance DOT 4 hydraulic fluid filling the brake circuit to transmit pedal force to all four calipers; replace every 2 years (hygroscopic).

parts.label: Brake Caliper Bleeder Valve
parts.function: One-way valve on each caliper used to purge air from the brake hydraulic circuit during bleeding.

parts.label: ABS Hydraulic Unit Mounting Bracket
parts.function: Secures the ABS/PSM hydraulic control unit to the chassis to prevent vibration-induced damage to hydraulic connections.

parts.label: Brake Booster Vacuum Line
parts.function: Supplies engine vacuum to the brake servo booster to maintain pedal assistance under all operating conditions.
